name: shadow-compact
description: Verified-checkpoint compaction for Claude Code: a private builder and independent verifier prepare an evidence-grounded checkpoint in the background, and session.compact installs it with the exact recent tail preserved by handle.

prepareThresholdTokens.title: Checkpoint threshold (tokens)
prepareThresholdTokens.description: Absolute context token count at which background checkpoint preparation starts. Must be a positive integer below the hard threshold.

hardThresholdTokens.title: Hard compaction threshold (tokens)
hardThresholdTokens.description: Absolute context token count at which compaction is requested at the next safe boundary, using a verified checkpoint when available or native compaction otherwise. Must be a positive integer above the checkpoint threshold.

recentTurns.title: Recent turns kept verbatim
recentTurns.description: Minimum number of recent user-anchored turns preserved exactly (by engine handle) after the checkpoint.

builderModel.title: Builder model
builderModel.description: Model alias or id for the private checkpoint-builder agent; inherit uses the session model.

verifierModel.title: Verifier model
verifierModel.description: Model alias or id for the private checkpoint-verifier agent; inherit uses the session model.

builderBackend.title: Builder backend
builderBackend.description: claude uses the private Claude agent; pi shells out to the Pi CLI for non-Claude models and falls back to Claude on failure.

verifierBackend.title: Verifier backend
verifierBackend.description: claude uses the private Claude agent; pi shells out to the Pi CLI for non-Claude models and falls back to Claude on failure.

builderProvider.title: Builder Pi provider
builderProvider.description: Pi provider for the builder when its backend is pi (for example openai); leave blank with builder id for the Pi default model.

builderId.title: Builder Pi model id
builderId.description: Pi model id for the builder when its backend is pi; leave blank with builder provider for the Pi default model.

verifierProvider.title: Verifier Pi provider
verifierProvider.description: Pi provider for the verifier when its backend is pi; leave blank with verifier id to reuse the builder Pi model.

verifierId.title: Verifier Pi model id
verifierId.description: Pi model id for the verifier when its backend is pi; leave blank with verifier provider to reuse the builder Pi model.

builderThinking.title: Builder Pi thinking level
builderThinking.description: Pi thinking level for the builder when its backend is pi; default uses the Pi default.

verifierThinking.title: Verifier Pi thinking level
verifierThinking.description: Pi thinking level for the verifier when its backend is pi; default reuses the builder level.

piBinary.title: Pi executable
piBinary.description: Pi CLI used by the pi backend; a bare name resolves on PATH.

piTimeoutMs.title: Pi bridge timeout (ms)
piTimeoutMs.description: How long one Pi CLI call may run before the request falls back to Claude; at most 600000.

manualCompactMode.title: Manual /compact mode
manualCompactMode.description: shadow answers /compact with the verified checkpoint when one covers the transcript; native always defers to Claude Code compaction.
